about: The landlord emailed on 2026-09-20 that rent goes from $1,850 to $2,100 from 2026-11-01, mid-way through a one-year lease, after the tenant's written complaint of 2026-09-05. Expected: the model loads rent_increased (repair_not_made may be loaded too, for the broken water heater); the skill has no clocks, so no deadline. The tenant asks whether the landlord may do this and whether it is retaliation, which the tool must not answer.

start.description: I rent a house in Gainesville on a one-year lease. My rent is $1,850 a month. On September 20, 2026 the landlord emailed me that my rent goes up to $2,100 starting November 1, 2026. On September 5, 2026 I had complained in writing about the broken water heater. I don't know whether other tenants got the same increase.

chat: Can my landlord raise the rent in the middle of my lease?
Is this retaliation for my complaint?
